# dim_advisor_leads

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.dim_advisor_leads` · dbt area: `growth`

Dimension table for advisor leads from Hubspot. Includes extensive derived fields covering attribution, location and region, qualification scoring, funnel stage booleans, lifecycle metrics. Each row is a single contact in Hubspot. Sourced from Hubspot, Google Analytics, and Google Sheets lookup tables.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `advisor_id` | Foreign Key. The 'User ID' in the Portal database, mapped to Hubspot contacts using the Hubspot 'Email' property and the Portal 'Personal Email'  >>  SOURCE - Portal |
| `advisor_lead_id` | *Primary* Key. Equivalent to Contact ID  >>  SOURCE - Hubspot |

| `attribution_medium` | How the Lead heard about us from a given Attribution Source. Equivalent to UTM Medium. From the Last Non-Direct Interaction attribution model. See description for 'Attribution System' for priorities. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics/ Hubspot/ Typeform |

| `attribution_system` | Fora has data about Leads from various systems. We prioritize the fullest data as part of our Last Non-Direct Interaction attribution model. (1) Google Analytics, matched using the email. (2) Hubspot Tracking Properties. (3) How Heard response on the Application. (4) Otherwise, no Attribution is available, and the Lead is assumed to have come directly to us. >> SOURCE - Google Analytics/ Hubspot/ Typeform |
